title: Changelog - July 2016
content:
## Changelog - July 2016


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093654

New Features: New XML Sitemap Generator was created. For further documentation click here . We updated our 404 error pages. Further documentation through this link . New Look and Feel for the Membership Level Edit Section. Master / Copy Feature for the Membership Features Section (BETA). Enhancements / Fixes: Full Optimization to the code Infrastructure with enhancements in all modules of the system. More than 20+ bugs fixed ranging from Backend, Admin Panel, Frontend and more. New Text Labels added to the Core Files. Text Labels: account_settings_label,account_settings_heading_label.
